extracted.intended_audience: Nonprofit organizations and individuals seeking Ford Foundation grants worldwide
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and basic rules for organizations and individuals seeking grants from the Ford Foundation, including eligibility signals, submission policy, fraud warnings, and funding priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: No unsolicited proposals accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note we do not accept any unsolicited grant proposals by mail, email or phone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should not send unsolicited proposals via mail, email, or phone. For more information and how to pursue funding opportunities, applicants are directed to visit the foundation's 'grant opportunities' page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Ford Foundation programs
rubrics_metrics.description: We fund a range of organizations around the world that align with our programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding is targeted to individuals and institutions working to address the underlying drivers of inequality; proposals should demonstrate strong alignment with the foundation's programmatic priorities and mission to fight inequality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission focus — address underlying drivers of inequality
rubrics_metrics.description: Advancing justice starts with supporting the individuals and institutions working tirelessly to address the underlying drivers of inequality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects and organizations that clearly target root causes of inequality and advance justice are the focus of Ford's grantmaking and are more likely to be considered for funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: No fees — beware of fraudulent solicitations
rubrics_metrics.description: There are individuals using Ford’s name without authorization suggesting that funds are forthcoming if they pay a fee. These messages are fraudulent. Please note that the foundation never charges a fee in connection with its grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and potential grantees should treat any solicitation that requests payment or a fee as fraudulent. Confirm communications via official Ford channels and do not send money to receive funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority: strengthening institutions and networks (BUILD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Because tackling inequality requires endurance, we have dedicated $2 billion of our budget to help strengthen social justice institutions. We call this effort BUILD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The BUILD initiative signals a funding priority for work that strengthens institutions and networks (endurance-focused capacity-building). Proposals focused on institutional strengthening may align with this priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research past and active grants before applying
rubrics_metrics.description: Our database displays active grants from the Ford Foundation. To delve deeper in our past grantmaking, annual reports from 1950-2012 can be viewed in the governance and financial statements archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should review the active grants database and past annual reports to understand Ford's past grantmaking patterns, typical grantees, and program focus areas to assess fit and tailor approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider other funders when funds are limited
rubrics_metrics.description: Because our funds are limited, we welcome you to learn more about other philanthropic organizations that may be able to further your work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a project does not clearly match Ford's priorities or if funding is constrained, applicants are advised to research and approach other philanthropic organizations that may be better resourced or aligned to their needs.
